name: Platinum Vape | 2g Disposable | Orange Pop
description:
Bright. Sweet. Seriously refreshing.

Orange Pop brings a bubbly blast of sweet orange, tangerine, and vanilla cream — a nostalgic citrus rush that tastes just like your favorite soda fizz. This sativa distillate hits smooth and uplifting, fueling focus, creativity, and feel-good energy that lasts.

Infused with Platinum’s clean, potent distillate and powered by a rechargeable 2G all-in-one, every hit delivers vibrant flavor, smooth clouds, and that signature Platinum perfection.

Flavor Profile: Orange Cream • Tangerine • Sweet Citrus

Effect: Uplifted • Creative • Energized

Device: Rechargeable 2G Distillate Disposable • All-In-One • Smooth Draw Design
